title: Cloud Accounts in practice
intro: Know who can open your links. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Samir Babayev shared the file Quarterly report with you
decisions.prompt: Is this share safe or risky?

artifact.subject: Samir Babayev shared the file Quarterly report with you
body: Samir: here is the report we discussed yesterday.

decisions.explain: A known colleague, an expected file, the service's own domain. Still check the address bar when it opens.

decisions.title: Shared salary files
decisions.prompt: Is this share safe or risky?

artifact.subject: 3 files sent to you: Salary increase 2027.pdf
body: Files will be deleted in 24 hours. Confirm your email password to view them.

decisions.explain: Wrong domain, a tempting topic, time pressure and a password request. A classic trap.

decisions.title: Share link before sending
decisions.prompt: You are about to send this share link to a partner. Is the share safe or risky?

artifact.title: Share: Quarterly report
body: Who has access: anyone with the link

decisions.explain: This link lets anyone edit. Change the access level before you send it.

decisions.title: Message from Gunay (team)
decisions.prompt: Is this share safe or risky?

artifact.name: Gunay (team)
body: I uploaded the documents to my personal cloud so I can work from home.

decisions.explain: A personal cloud is outside your organisation's control. Keep work files only in the approved service.

decisions.title: Old open links will be closed
decisions.prompt: Is this share safe or risky?

artifact.subject: Old open links will be closed
body: On Friday, open links older than 90 days will close automatically. No action is needed from you.

decisions.explain: Correct address, no link, no request. This is a useful clean-up.
